newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Victorias woes will not hurt banks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Victorias woes will not hurt banks.

text.p: ING Baring Securities said on Friday exposure of several local banks to the heavily-indebted Victorias Milling Co was no cause for alarm and recommended a buy on banking issues.

"We would like to highlight that there is no cause for concern. Not only are the loans amply collateralised, they represent a very small part of the bank's respective loan portfolio," said Kathy-Ann Javellana, analyst at ING Baring in a sectoral outlook released on Friday.
Victorias, the biggest sugar miller in the country, has secured a moratorium from 32 banks for its debts amounting to 4.4 billion pesos.
Some of Victorias creditors include Bank of the Philippine Islands, Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co and the Philippine National Bank.
"We view any further weakness in trading as an opportunity for investors to establish positions in the sector," Javellana said.

In late trade, BPI dipped by one peso to 182 pesos and Metrobank dropped by 10 pesos to 685 pesos. Bucking the trend was PNB which gained 2.50 pesos to 307.50. In early trade, however, the issue shed some points.
